inputs.prompt:
Translate these narration lines:
{
 "s01": "Every family has a beginning. Ours begins at the old walls of Harar.",
 "s02": "My great-grandparents came here from far away, carrying little more than a skill.",
 "s03": "My great-grandfather was a tailor on Makina Girgir, the street of sewing machines.",
 "s04": "My grandmother kept a small stall by the street. The stitches became trade, and the trade became a living.",
 "s05": "What she earned, she saved, for the ones who would come after her.",
 "s06": "My mother helped her at the stall by day, and carried her schoolbooks with her.",
 "s07": "At night, when she was tired, she studied anyway.",
 "s08": "And one day, she graduated.",
 "s09": "Then she worked long hours in a government office, and gave everything she had so that I could learn.",
 "s10": "I graduated in software engineering with honours, won a scholarship for my master's, and today I am an AI engineer, with comforts they never had.",
 "s11": "Nothing I have is mine alone. It is the work of everyone who came before me. Now it is my turn to take us a little further."
}
Use this glossary:
{"tailors": "ልብስ ሰፊዎች", "my mother": "እናቴ", "merchants": "ነጋዴዎች"}
inputs.system: You translate documentary film narration for voice-over. Write natural, spoken Amharic in its native script (no transliteration), for a young woman narrating in the first person about her own family. Use short sentences written for the ear, warm and simple, never bureaucratic. Keep the meaning of each line exactly; do not add facts, names, places or dates. Keep 'Harar' as the city name. 'My' must stay possessive (my mother, my great-grandparents). Return only a JSON object mapping each line id to its translation.
